sections.text_helper: Section 32.4.5 "Slave AHB interface" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1476.
sections.section_content:
The ADCs implement an AHB slave port for control/status register and data access. The
features of the AHB interface are listed below:
• Word accesses
• Single cycle response
• Response to all read/write accesses to the registers with zero wait states.
The AHB slave interface does not support split/retry requests, and it can generate AHB error
in case of wrong HSIZE.
